title: Massacre of Arabs during the Zanzibar Revolution
text: In January 1964, during and following the Zanzibar Revolution, Arab residents of Zanzibar were victims of targeted violence committed by the island’s majority Black African population. Arabs were mass murdered, raped, tortured and deported from the island by Black African militiamen under the Afro-Shirazi Party and Umma Party. The exact death toll is unknown, although scholarly sources generally estimate the number of Arabs killed to be at least several thousand, a significant fraction of the total Arab population. It has been described by some, including a number of scholars, as an act of genocide.
